articles.summary: TUPELO, Miss., Aug. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The board of directors of Renasant Corporation (NYSE: RNST) approved the payment of a quarterly cash dividend of twenty-four cents ($0.24) per share to be paid September 30, 2026, to shareholders of record as of September 16, 2026.
articles.title: Renasant Corporation Declares Quarterly Dividend

articles.summary: TUPELO, Miss., Aug. 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Today, Renasant Corporation (the “Company”) announced that Catherine Mealor will join the Company as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
